focus: correctness (closing recheck of all 16 carried findings at HEAD) plus the unreached cache, freshness and rebuild-lock slice

findingDetails.title: The corrupt-lock reclaim deletes a lock another publisher is still acquiring
findingDetails.scopeProof: Acquisition publishes the token in two syscalls (openSync 'wx' at :155, writeFileSync at :156); readLockTokenAndAge maps an empty file to {token:null} at :139-146; only the stale branch re-reads and compares the token (:174-185) while the nil branch rmSyncs unconditionally (:186-191). The lock stress suite covers stale-token reclamation twice (:145-171, :182-191) and never the empty-file branch.
findingDetails.case: The daemon watcher rebuilds while an operator runs advisor_rebuild; the second publisher reads the lock between the first publisher's openSync and writeFileSync, sees an empty file, deletes the live lock, and both publish generation N+1 for two different states.

results.summary: The documented authentication invariant is unmet in every configuration: trust is caller-declared and the shipped launcher makes absent authority trusted. R2-P1-001 retained at P1.
The gate description names the daemon-side env knob and 7/7 root-relative test rows resolve; the sole gap is the :16 citation missing its runtime/ prefix (R3-P2-002, scope narrowed).
The packet carries no checklist.md or acceptance-criteria.md, so there are no rows to evidence.

noveltyJustification: weightedNew = 1 (R5-P2-001 at P2 weight 1); weightedRefinement = 0.5 (R3-P2-002 scope sharpened at half weight); weightedTotal = 20 (15 carried P2 at weight 1 plus the active P1 at weight 5). 1.5/20 = 0.075, below the 0.10 convergence threshold. The iteration's value is confirmation rather than novelty: 16 findings re-verified at HEAD, one retained at P1 against a downgrade hypothesis, one sharpened, one new defect found in a module no prior pass had read.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: 154 source files and about 50k lines under review; the closing pass spans the score pipeline, the daemon gates, four cache modules and a rebuild lock

targetSelection.selectionReason: Every carried finding was re-read at its cited line, and the unread slice was narrowed to the modules that own cache state and rebuild publication

searchLedger.invariant: A freshness result cached for 15 minutes must not survive a rebuild that changes skill sources

searchActions.result: getOrCompute is a plain TTL/LRU over the caller key

searchLedger.rationale: The key carries the content signature, so a rebuild misses rather than hits; the 15-minute TTL is redundant, not load-bearing
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: key includes sourceSignature and generation, so staleness cannot be observed via this cache

searchLedger.hypothesis: A rebuild path leaves live prompt-cache entries keyed by the old source signature

searchActions.result: two production invalidators plus the class definition
get and set share performance.now(); signature invalidation sweeps by stored signature

searchLedger.rationale: Both doors invalidate on signature change and the key embeds the signature, so no stale hit is constructible
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: invalidation wired on the request path and on the freshness listener

searchLedger.hypothesis: Two publishers can both hold the generation lock because the token is published after the lock file exists

searchActions.result: openSync 'wx' then writeFileSync; nil-token branch rmSyncs unconditionally
stale-token reclamation covered twice; empty-file branch not covered

searchLedger.rationale: Confirmed by statement order and by the read mapping at :139-146; the window is narrow but unpinned by tests

searchLedger.hypothesis: A doc-harvest failure commits nodes while freshness reports live

searchActions.result: harvest runs after tx() and before setMetadata; a throw skips both
publish happens only after indexSkillMetadata returns

searchLedger.rationale: The throw leaves freshness stale, which is the fail-closed ordering
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no generation publish precedes a complete harvest

searchLedger.hypothesis: R2-P1-001 is downgradable to P2 because caller-asserted trust nullifies the gate's impact

searchActions.result: metadata.trusted true short-circuits; silent metadata falls to the env default
reach calibration keeps a failed promise P1 or higher

searchLedger.rationale: The downgrade hypothesis is rejected: the guard's own doc line promises to reject absent metadata, and that exact input class is accepted in the shipped configuration
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: doctrine reach calibration keeps a promise-failure at P1 regardless of impact-side arguments

searchLedger.hypothesis: R3-P2-002 is a false positive because the cited parity suite exists

searchActions.result: :16 cites tests/skill-advisor-cli-manifest-parity.vitest.ts without the runtime/ prefix; :61-67 are root-relative

searchActions.queryOrPath: existence check of every runtime/tests path cited in the file

searchLedger.rationale: Not a false positive, but narrower than recorded: the defect is the missing prefix in a table whose siblings are root-relative, so the citation does not resolve from the repo root
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: the suite exists; only the citation prefix is wrong

searchLedger.invariant: Every listed module must be read before the run can claim it clean

searchActions.queryOrPath: wc -l over the listed module directories
searchActions.result: 4920 lines across 21 files not read by this pass

searchLedger.rationale: The 24-call budget went to the 16-finding recheck; the remaining modules are named for the next run rather than claimed clean
searchLedger.deferredReason: budget exhausted at iteration 5 of 5; no generation of this review has read lifecycle/ or derived/
